summary: A layer may name an area or a section the record does not carry. The host keeps it and returns it in the next read, or refuses with its reason.

then.note: This is the one act of arranging that does not rearrange what the host sent: it names something new. The component draws it at once from the layer, so a person sees what they made, but it survives the next record.load only if the host returns it. A host that will not keep a new area answers refused with a reason rather than applied, and the component reads the record again.
